notes.title: Quick Update to export Custom Stages to PDF
notes.notes:
Just got a request which I thought would be a great idea, so I took a day to get it done. It's still rudimentary but it works well.

Some of the players use PractisimVR to build custom stages for their real-world IPSC/USPSA matches and wanted a way to export the stage design and description into a PDF.

The save function in the Stage Designer will now automatically export the stage description PDF file into this folder: %appdata%/../LocalLow/AncientSky Games/PractisimVR/customstages

Here's an example:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28505145/50f78315c20ae33aaad656eeb1b2b3d5118ece11.png[/img]

Give it a whirl and give me some feedback.

Loke

notes.title: Update #32 - New USPSA Long Course, Waypoint changes
notes.notes:
Week #32. A light update this time with a new long course and changes to the Waypoint system after getting some feedback from the community. We've changed waypoints to only remember position instead of rotation. Including rotation introduces a bug during replays because the rotation is controller exlusively by the player, forcing the player to rotate will be jarring. We've found that just moving the player and letting the player look where he/she wants, is more natural and works pretty well. Give it a try and let me know what you think.


Changelog v0.44
* New USPSA Stage - Lock Stock and Too Many Barrels
* Adjusted Waypoint type to position only
* Waypoint is optional and available in the Advanced Preference
* Removed rotation capability for Waypoints
* Fixed teleport while menu is open
* Added more multi language text

notes.title: Update #31 - Waypoint Locomotion, New USPSA Stage, Movement fixes
notes.notes:
Week #31. After much cajoling by the community over the past few months, I've relented and implemented Waypoint locomotion. Now you can specify waypoints during the stage using the GRIP button, then after the buzzer, hold down GRIP for more than 1s to instantly teleport to the next waypoint. That way you can plan your stage positions before starting, and move through the stage without messing with trackpad or teleporting locomotion styles. Give it a shot and let me know how it works. I'm surprised to say that I'm pretty impressed with the playability of it.


Changelog v0.43
* Waypoint Locomotion
* New USPSA Long Course
* Allow movement in passages
* Swapped clamshell for Flap-Up Target in Gallery
* Fixed disable movement override
* Fixed connecting menu activators
* Fixed shot calling stage start problem
* Fixed stage designer loading issue


Enjoy!
